blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods tend to outperform contrastive ones, a pattern that sits awkwardly with recent evidence that pixel reconstruction yields uninformative features for natural-image classification. We argue this discrepancy is not an accident but a consequence of how HTR signal is distributed in pixel space. By probing the input distribution directly, we show that HTR’s discriminative content is concentrated in the high-variance pixel subspace and is essentially absent from the low-variance one, the inverse of the structure observed for image classification. Under this view, the right SSL family becomes predictable: objectives that preserve high-variance pixel content should transfer best. We test this prediction across six SSL methods spanning three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA-style, and contrastive image–image and image–text), under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages. In the full-label setting, pixel-grounded SSL produces the lowest CER on every benchmark and every probe, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only via the readout, and is the only family that benefits from real-data pretraining. Pixel-grounded representations are also more label-efficient. A geometric property of the encoder, its alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace, predicts CER within every SSL method we test. With a pretrained LLM decoder, a frozen pixel-grounded encoder is already competitive with fully fine-tuned supervised baselines, and full fine-tuning beats them on the mean and ranks first or second on every benchmark. These results challenge the prevailing view that pixel reconstruction wastes capacity on irrelevant detail: whether reconstruction is wasted depends on where the discriminative signal lives in the input.
blocks.zh: 在手写文字识别(HTR)的自我监督预训中,像素重建方法往往优于对比性方法,这种模式尴尬地与近代证据表明像素重建产生自然图像分类的无成形特征相对. 我们认为这种差异不是偶然的,而是HTR信号如何在像素空间中分布的结果. 通过直接检测输入分布,我们显示HTR的区别性内容集中在高变异像素的子空间,并且基本上没有出现在低变异的子空间,即图像分类观察到的结构的反向. 在这种观点下,正确的SSL家族变得可以预测:保留高变异像素内容的目标应该最好地转移. 我们通过6个SSL方法测试这一预测,这些方法涵盖3个家庭(像素基于的MIM,JEPA风格,以及对比图像-图像和图像-文本),在匹配编码器、数据和评价协议下,使用5种语言的6个笔迹基准。 在全标签设置中,像素定位的SSL在每个基准和每个探测器上产生最低CER,暴露每个位置的字符信息,其他家庭只能通过读取恢复,也是唯一受益于真实数据预训的家庭. 以像素为底的表示方式也具有更高的标签效率. 编码器的几何属性,它与高变量像素子空间的对齐,预言了我们测试的每一种SSL方法中的CER. 使用预先训练的LLM解码器,冷冻的像素地面编码器已经具有完全微调的有监督的基线的竞争力,完全微调在平均值上击败它们,并在每个基准上排名第一或第二. 这些结果对普遍的看法提出了挑战,即像素重建的废物处理能力与细节无关:重建是否浪费取决于投入中存在的歧视性信号。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) aims to transcribe handwritten content into machine-readable text, supporting applications from the digitization of historical archives to form automation and document retrieval. Despite notable advances in recent years [ 26 ] , performance still hinges on the availability of large quantities of labeled real handwriting, which are expensive to collect and often unavailable for the long tail of historical, regional, and low-resource scripts [ 25 , 49 ] . The vast variability in human handwriting such as writing style, ligatures, slant, ink, paper, and degradation means that systems trained on one writer or one historical period generalize poorly to others, leaving the field perpetually data-hungry [ 26 ] . Synthetic data is the natural response to this shortage: rendered from a pool of fonts at essentially zero annotation cost, it can be produced in arbitrary quantities and made multilingual by construction. Yet synthetic handwriting fails to reproduce the subtle nuances of real handwriting, and models trained only on synthetic data exhibit a pronounced synthetic-to-real gap that does not close without seeing real samples. This gap is precisely the regime in which representation quality matters most, since no decoder, language prior, or test-time augmentation can recover information the encoder did not learn to expose.
blocks.zh: 手写文本识别(HTR)旨在将手写内容转换成机器可读文本,支持历史档案数字化的应用,形成自动化和文件检索. 尽管近年来取得了显著进展[26],但业绩仍然取决于能否获得大量贴有标签的真实笔迹,收集这些笔迹的费用昂贵,而且往往无法用于历史、区域和低资源文字的长尾[25,49]。 写作风格、结扎、斜线、墨水、纸张和退化等人类笔迹的巨大变化,意味着在一个作家或一个历史时期接受过训练的系统对其他人的概括性很差,使这个领域永远缺乏数据[26]。 合成数据是对这种短缺的自然反应:从一个基本零注价的字体库中制得,可以任意生产数量,通过建造而成为多语种. 然而,合成笔迹无法复制真实笔迹的微妙细微差别,只接受合成数据培训的模型显示出一个显著的合成到现实的缺口,没有看到真实的样本就不会接近. 这种差距恰恰是代表质量最重要的制度,因为没有解码器、语言前期或测试时间的增强能够恢复编码器未学会暴露的信息。

blocks.en: Self-supervised pretraining (SSL) [ 30 , 36 , 37 , 9 ] is the standard tool for closing this kind of gap, with three families dominating the literature: (1) reconstruction-based methods, also known as Masked Image Modeling (MIM), which reconstruct masked content in pixel space [ 30 , 59 ] ; (2) contrastive methods, which optimize an instance-discrimination loss in either an image–image [ 31 , 16 , 17 ] or an image–text [ 52 , 62 ] setting; and (3) embedding-predictive architectures , of which Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) [ 37 , 7 ] are the canonical instance, predicting the representations of masked regions in a learned latent space.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的预训(SSL)[30,36,37,9]是缩小这种差距的标准工具,有三个家庭主导文献:(1)基于重建的方法,又称蒙面图像模型(MIM),在像素空间中重建蒙面内容[30,59];(2)对比方法,在图像-图像[31,16,17]或图像-文本[52,62]设置中优化一个实例-歧视损失;(3)嵌入-预测性建筑,其中联合Embedding Predictive Architectures(JEPA)[37,7]是能够预测所学潜伏空间中蒙面区域表现的典型实例.

blocks.en:
In HTR, the existing SSL literature does not provide a clean answer to the question of which family is best, nor a principled understanding of why [ 49 ] . Comparisons across studies are difficult to interpret because pretraining data, evaluation protocols, and probe choices vary substantially across methods [ 49 , 65 , 4 ] .
This question matters because the broader self-supervised literature has converged on the intuition that pixel-space reconstruction does not yield representations useful for perception [ 10 ] : the underlying assumption is that semantic tasks depend on high-level abstractions, and that recovering low-level pixel detail is incidental to that goal: that capacity spent on such detail is capacity wasted. This view has driven the field toward JEPA-style methods [ 37 , 7 , 12 , 6 ] , which by construction predict in a learned latent space and discard pixel-level reconstruction altogether. In this paper, we ask whether the same assumption holds for transcription tasks, where the unit of recognition is a character rather than an object category. We use HTR as a testbed and, to do so rigorously, adapt JEPA methods to handwriting for the first time. Our central argument, however, is sharper: HTR is structurally different from semantic understanding tasks, and the signal that determines the transcription lives, paradoxically, in exactly the low-level detail that JEPA discards. The very content the field’s dominant philosophy treats as noise is, on HTR, the signal itself. We show that pixel-grounded methods outperform JEPA-style and contrastive ones across all six benchmarks and every SSL protocol we test, and we explain why through a measurable property of the encoder: alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace, which correlates strongly with downstream CER.
blocks.zh:
在HTR中,现有的SSL文献没有为哪个家庭是最好的问题提供干净的答案,也没有对为什么[49]的原则理解. 不同研究的比较很难解释,因为培训前数据、评价协议和探险选择在方法上差别很大[49、65、4]。
这个问题之所以重要,是因为更广泛的自我监督的文献在像素空间重建不会产生对感知有用的表示的直觉上趋同[10]: 基本假设是,语义性任务取决于高层次抽象,恢复低层次像素细节是实现这一目标的附带因素:在这种细节上花费的能力是能力浪费。 这种观点驱使田野走向JEPA式的方法[37, 7, 12, 6], 通过建筑可以预测到在学习到的潜在空间和丢弃像素级的重建。 在本文中,我们问同一假设是否适用于抄录任务,即识别单位是一个字符而不是对象类别。 我们使用HTR作为试验床,为了严格地这样做,对JEPA方法进行了第一次的笔迹修改. 然而,我们的核心论点是更尖锐的:HTR在结构上不同于语义理解任务,而决定抄录过程的信号,自相矛盾的是,正是JEPA抛弃的低层次细节. 在HTR上,这个领域的主要哲学认为是噪音本身。 我们显示,以像素为基础的方法超越了JEPA的风格和对比性方法,这些方法贯穿于我们测试的所有六个基准和每个SSL协议中,我们解释为什么通过编码器的可测量属性:与高变位像素子空间的配合,这与下游CER有很强的联系.

blocks.en: Contributions: (C1) A structural account of why pixel-grounded SSL is the right objective for HTR. The HTR signal lives in the high-variance pixel subspace, the inverse of natural-image classification, and an encoder’s alignment with that subspace predicts its probe CER within every SSL method we test. (C2) The first adaptation of JEPA-style methods to text recognition. We adapt I-JEPA and V-JEPA-2 to HTR as the first test of the JEPA philosophy outside its validated domain. (C3) The first rigorous, line-level SSL comparison for HTR. We evaluate six SSL methods spanning three families (Pixel-MIM, JEPA-style, Contrastive) under same encoder, data, and evaluation protocols across six benchmarks in five languages, in both synthetic and real pretraining regimes. Findings from this comparison are summarized in the abstract and detailed in Sec. 5 .
blocks.zh: 贡献:(C1) 一个结构账户,说明为什么像素基于SSL是HTR的正确目标. HTR信号生活在高变异像素子空间,自然图像分类的反向,以及一个编码器与该子空间的对接,预言它的探测器CER在我们测试的每一个SSL方法中. (C2) JEPA风格方法首次适应文本识别. 我们把I-JEPA和V-JEPA-2修改为HTR,作为JEPA哲学在它被验证的域外的第一个测试. (C3) HTR的第一个严格,线级的SSL比较. 我们用同样的编码器、数据和评价协议, 在合成和真正的预训制度下, 比较结果摘要载于第5节。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Handwritten Text Recognition.
blocks.zh: 2.1 手写文本识别。

blocks.en: HTR has long been dominated by recurrent architectures: bidirectional LSTMs [ 29 , 32 ] trained with the Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) objective [ 28 ] held the state of the art on standard benchmarks for over a decade [ 5 , 54 , 53 , 2 ] . Attention-based encoder-decoder models [ 8 ] later emerged as strong alternatives [ 33 , 35 , 1 , 20 ] , and a comparative analysis by Michael et al. [46] provides a detailed account of these sequence-to-sequence approaches. The introduction of Vision Transformers [ 22 ] reshaped the field by enabling more scalable visual encoders, used either in pure encoder-decoder pipelines [ 38 , 47 , 48 , 57 ] or paired with CTC decoding [ 58 , 19 , 13 ] . Modern HTR systems built on Transformer encoders depend heavily on large labeled corpora for pretraining [ 38 , 21 ] , which is the bottleneck this paper addresses. Self-supervised learning is the standard tool for relaxing this dependence, and a growing body of work has applied it to text recognition [ 61 , 49 , 4 ] . The next subsection reviews this literature in detail.
blocks.zh: HTR长期以反复出现的架构为主:双向LSTMs [29,32] 与连接者临时分类(CTC)目标一起培训 [28] 保持了十多年来标准基准的最新水平[5,54,53,2]. 基于注意的编码器-解码器模型[8]后来出现为强替代品[33,35,1,20],由Michael等人进行比较分析. [46] 详细介绍了这些顺序至顺序方法. 引入Vision Transformers [22] 重新塑造了场面,使视觉编码更加可扩展,或者用于纯编码器-解码器管道[38,47,48,57],或者与CTC解码[58,19,13]配对. 现代 建立在变形器编码器上的HTR系统严重依赖大标注的corpora进行预训[38,21],这就是本文地址的瓶颈. 自我监督的学习是放松这种依赖性的标准工具,越来越多的工作将其应用于文本识别[61,49,4]. 下一节详细评述了这一文献。

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-supervised pretraining
blocks.zh: 2.2 自我监督的预训

blocks.en: Three families of visual self-supervised pretraining are now standard. Reconstruction-based methods, also known as Masked Image Modeling (MIM), reconstruct masked image content either in pixel space [ 30 , 59 ] or in a discrete token space [ 11 ] . Embedding-prediction methods, of which Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) [ 37 ] are the canonical instance, predict the representations of masked regions in a learned latent space [ 7 , 12 , 6 ] . Contrastive methods optimize an instance-discrimination loss in either an image–image [ 31 , 16 , 17 ] or an image–text [ 52 , 62 ] setting. The relative merits of these families depend strongly on the downstream task. Balestriero and Lecun [10] have recently argued that pixel-space reconstruction concentrates a model’s capacity on a subspace of the data that explains pixel variance but is uninformative for perception, making MIM ill-suited to natural-image classification under linear probing. This argument has driven the field toward JEPA-style methods, which by construction predict in a learned latent space rather than in pixel space. We revisit this argument in the HTR setting and find the opposite structure: the high-variance pixel subspace of handwritten line images is precisely where the discriminative signal lives, so the property that hurts MIM on classification is the property that benefits it on transcription.
blocks.zh: 视觉自导自演预训三家现已达到标准. 基于重建的方法,又称蒙面图像模型(MIM),在像素空间[30,59]或离散的符号空间重建蒙面图像内容. 嵌入式预测方法,其中联合预测建筑(JEPA)[37]是犬科的实例,预测了蒙蔽区域在所学潜在空间中的表示[7,12,6]. 对比方法在图像-图像[31、16、17]或图像-文本[52、62]设置中优化实例歧视损失。 这些家庭的相对优点在很大程度上取决于下游任务。 Balestriero和Lecun[10]最近认为,像素-空间重建将模型的能力集中在数据的一个子空间上,该子空间解释像素差异,但对感知却不具有信息性,这使得MIM不适合线性测试下的自然图像分类. 这一论点将领域推向JEPA式的方法,通过建筑在已学到的潜伏空间而不是像素空间中预测。 我们在HTR设置中重温这个论点,发现相反的结构:手写线形图像的高变异像素子空间正是歧义信号所居住的地方,所以在分类上伤害MIM的属性就是在转录上有利于它的财产.

blocks.en: 2.3 Self-supervised pretraining for text recognition
blocks.zh: 2.3 自行监督的文本识别预训

blocks.en: Prior SSL work in text recognition [ 49 ] has explored three of the four families introduced above. Pixel-grounded MIM has been the dominant route for visual SSL in TR: TextDIAE [ 56 ] pretrains a ViT encoder with masking, blurring, and debinarization pretext tasks; DualMAE [ 51 ] decouples visual and semantic feature learning with a dual masked autoencoder; MaskOCR [ 44 ] uses vertical strip masking to respect the horizontal flow of text lines; and DiG [ 60 ] combines SimMIM-style reconstruction with contrastive learning. Image–image contrastive methods adapt MoCo-style [ 17 ] instance discrimination by reorganizing the contrastive unit: SeqCLR [ 4 ] contrasts at the frame level, PerSec [ 40 ] at the stroke–semantic level, ChaCo [ 65 ] at the character level, CMT-Co [ 64 ] via character-movement pretext, and RCLSTR [ 63 ] via textual relations; SimAN [ 43 ] replaces the contrastive objective with a generative one. Image–text contrastive pretraining has not been adapted to TR as an SSL objective: existing work uses CLIP only as a frozen pretrained model, either fine-tuned for STR [ 66 ] or fused into an existing recognizer [ 3 ] . JEPA-style pretraining is fully absent: no published work adapts I-JEPA [ 7 ] , V-JEPA-2 [ 6 ] , or any embedding-prediction objective to text recognition, in either the scene or handwritten setting.
blocks.zh: 以往SSL在文本识别方面的工作[49]已经探索了上述四个家庭中的三个家庭. Pixel定位的MIM一直是视觉SSL在TR中的主要路径: TextDIAE [56] 预装一个带有遮掩,模糊,去比化借口任务的ViT编码器; DualMAE [51] 以双面罩自动编码器解耦的视觉和语义特征学习; MaskOCR [44] 使用垂直条形面具来尊重文本线的横向流;以及 DiG [60] 结合SimMIM风格的重建与对比性学习. 图像-图像对比法通过重组对比单位来适应 MoCo 风格 [17] 实例歧视: SeqCLR [4] 对比帧级,PerSec [40] 对比中风-语义级,ChaCo [65] 对比字符级,CMT-Co [64] 通过性格移动借口, RCLSTR [63] 通过文字关系; SimAN [43] 替换对比目标为分族目标. 图像 - 文本对比性预训尚未作为SSL目标适应TR:现有工作只使用CLIP作为冷冻预训模型,或者为STR[66]进行微调,或者被熔化成现有的识别器[3]. 完全没有JEPA式的预训:没有出版的作品将I-JEPA[7],V-JEPA-2[6],或者任何嵌入的预测目标都适应于文字识别,无论是在现场还是手写环境中.

blocks.en: Our work supplies a structural account, grounded in the variance geometry of handwritten text-line images, and tests it under matched conditions across six methods [ 30 , 59 , 7 , 6 , 17 , 62 ] , including the first study of JEPA-style methods on HTR.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作提供一种基于手写文字线图像不同几何的结构性叙述,并在相应条件下通过六种方法进行测试[30、59、7、6、17、62],包括首次研究JEPA式HTR方法。

blocks.en: 3 HTR signal lives in the top-variance subspace
blocks.zh: 3 HTR 信号位于上变速子空间

blocks.en: Balestriero and Lecun [10] argue that for natural-image classification, the discriminative signal lives in the low-variance directions of the input pixel distribution, not the high-variance ones. They support this empirically on TinyImageNet, where classifiers trained on the bottom-variance components of the input outperform those trained on the top-variance ones (Fig. 1 of [ 10 ] ). Pixel-space reconstruction objectives are therefore misallocated for classification: the L2 reconstruction loss is dominated by the high-variance pixel directions that the classifier does not need, so the encoder is forced to spend capacity on representations the downstream task discards. This argument has driven recent work toward JEPA-style methods that predict in latent space rather than pixel space [ 7 ] , on the assumption that the variance structure of natural-image classification is the variance structure of perception.
blocks.zh: Balestriero和Lecun [10]认为,对于自然成像分类,歧义信号生活在输入像素分布的低变异方向,而不是高变异方向. 他们支持在TinyImageNet上的经验性地支持这一点,在该网中,对输入的底层变异成分进行培训的分类人员比对上变异成分进行培训的人员要好(图[10])。 因此,像素空间重建目标被错划为分类: L2重建损失以分类器不需要的高变位像素方向为主,因此编码器被迫将容量用于表示下游任务丢弃物. 这一论点推动了最近对JEPA风格方法的工作,这种方法在潜在空间而不是像素空间中预测[7],其假设是自然图像分类的不同结构是认知的不同结构.

blocks.en: HTR has the opposite structure. A handwritten line image is almost entirely ink against background, and the discriminative signal is the configuration of strokes; the directions of greatest pixel variance across a dataset are precisely the strokes the recognizer needs to read. We hypothesize that HTR signal lives in the high-variance pixel subspace and is absent from the low-variance one.
blocks.zh: HTR有相反的结构. 手写线形图像在背景下几乎完全为墨,区别信号是中风的配置;跨数据集的最大像素差异方向正是识别器需要读取的中风. 我们假设HTR信号 生活在高变异像素的子空间 并且没有出现在低变异的空间里

blocks.en: To test this, we adapt the projection-then-probe protocol of Balestriero and Lecun [10] from classification to HTR. For each dataset, we compute pixel-PCA on its training images and form two reconstructions per image: one using the smallest set of high-variance principal components (top-K) capturing a fraction p p of the total variance, and one using the smallest set of low-variance components matching the same variance budget (bot-K). We train an identical BiLSTM–CTC probe on each reconstruction; full construction details are in App. A .
blocks.zh: 为了测试这一点,我们把Balestriro和Lecun[10]的投影-当时的探测协议从分类调整为HTR. 对于每个数据集,我们计算其训练图像的像素-PCA,并形成每个图像的两个重建:一个是使用最小的一组高变异主元件(top-K)捕获总差异的p分数,一个是使用最小的一组低变异元件匹配相同的差异预算(bot-K). 我们每一次重建都训练同样的BILSTM-CTC探测器;完整的建筑细节载于App. A.

blocks.en: The result reverses the finding of Balestriero and Lecun [10] for natural-image classification: the top-variance probe approaches the full-image baseline once p p exceeds a small threshold, while the bot-variance probe remains near ceiling regardless of how much variance is retained (Fig. 1 ). Qualitative reconstructions agree: only the top-variance subspace preserves legible text (Fig. 2 ). The asymmetry is large and consistent across six benchmarks spanning five languages and several historical periods, indicating that handwriting recognition is the inverse of natural-image classification: the discriminative signal concentrates in the high-variance pixel subspace.
blocks.zh: 结果逆转了Balestriero和Lecun[10]对自然成像分类的发现:顶变异探测器在p超过小阈值后接近全变异基线,而瓶变异探测器无论保留了多少差异(图1)仍然接近上限. 定性重建达成一致:只有上变位子空间保留可辨读文本(图2 ). 非对称性很大,跨越了五种语言和几个历史时期的6个基准是一致的,表明笔迹识别是自然图像分类的反向: 歧义信号集中在高变位像素子空间.

blocks.en: The structural account predicts that SSL families whose features preserve high-variance pixel content should transfer better to HTR than families that discard it. The remainder of the paper tests this prediction across six methods drawn from three SSL families.
blocks.zh: 结构账户预测,其特性保持高变异像素内容的SSL家族应该比放弃其功能的家庭更好地转移到HTR. 文件的其余部分通过从三个SSL家庭抽取的6种方法测试这一预测.

blocks.en: Figure 1: HTR signal lives in the high-variance pixel subspace. CTC probe CER as a function of the fraction of pixel principal components retained, on six real handwriting benchmarks. Top- K K projections (blue) recover the full-image baseline (dashed) using only the high-variance directions; bot- K K projections (red) remain near ceiling. The asymmetry is the inverse of the structure reported by Balestriero and Lecun [10] for natural-image classification.

Per dataset, the top- K K row uses the fewest high-variance pixel-PCA components capturing 80 % 80\% of total variance; the bot- K K row uses as many low-variance components as needed to match the same variance budget. Only the top- K K reconstruction preserves legible text. This is the inverse of natural-image classification [ 10 ] .

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We compare six SSL methods spanning three families, under two pretraining regimes and three evaluation protocols. Loss functions and per-method hyperparameters are reported in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了涉及3个家庭的6种SSL方法,分为两个培训前制度和三个评估协议。 损失功能和每方法的超参数在附录中报告。

blocks.en: 4.1 SSL families
blocks.zh: 4.1 SSL家庭

blocks.en: We choose two canonical instances per family rather than test every text-recognition adaptation, since our goal is to characterize the behavior of the underlying SSL objective rather than of any particular TR-specific recipe. Each instance below is the foundation that subsequent TR adaptations build on.
blocks.zh: 我们每个家庭选择两个划线的例子,而不是检验每个文本识别的适应性,因为我们的目标是描述基本SSL目标的行为,而不是任何特定的TR特定配方。 以下每个实例都是随后TR调整的基础.

blocks.en: Pixel-grounded methods, also known as Masked Image Modeling (MIM), reconstruct masked image content directly in pixel space. The reconstruction loss is computed pixel-wise, so its gradient is dominated by the directions of largest pixel variance and the encoder is required to retain high-variance content [ 10 , 9 ] . We use MAE [ 30 ] and SimMIM [ 59 ] : MAE encodes only visible patches and reconstructs masked ones with a lightweight decoder, while SimMIM encodes all patches (masked ones replaced with a learned token) and reconstructs through a linear projection.
blocks.zh: 像素定位方法,又称面具图像模型(MIM),直接在像素空间重建蒙面图像内容. 重建损失是按像素计算,因此其梯度以最大像素差异的方向为主,编码器需要保留高变量内容[10,9]. 我们使用MAE [30]和SimMIM [59]: MAE只编码可见的补丁,重建带有轻量级解码器的蒙面补丁,而SimMIM则编码所有补丁(用学习过的代号替换的蒙面补丁),并通过线性投影重建.

blocks.en: JEPA-style methods predict the representations of masked regions in a learned latent space rather than in pixel space [ 37 , 7 ] . Because the loss never sees pixels, the encoder can discard high-variance pixel content as long as it is also unpredictable in the latent space. No prior work has adapted I-JEPA, V-JEPA, or any embedding-prediction objective to text recognition. We therefore test the two canonical instances directly: I-JEPA [ 7 ] and V-JEPA-2 [ 6 ] . We feed both methods vertical patches of the line image, treating them as the patches (I-JEPA) or frames (V-JEPA-2) of the original input formats, to keep input conditions matched with the other families. Full adaptation details are in Appendix B.3 .
blocks.zh: JEPA的风格方法预测了蒙蔽区域在有学问的潜在空间而不是像素空间中的表现形式[37,7]. 由于损失从未看到像素,编码器可以丢弃高变异的像素内容,只要它在潜在空间中也是不可预知的. 以往的工作没有调整I-JEPA、V-JEPA,也没有调整文本识别的嵌入预测目标。 因此,我们直接检验两个犬科案例:I-JEPA[7]和V-JEPA-2[6]。 我们为线条图像的垂直补丁提供两种方法,将它们作为原始输入格式的补丁(I-JEPA)或帧(V-JEPA-2),以保持输入条件与其他家族的匹配. 完整的修改细节见附录B.3。

blocks.en: Image–image contrastive methods optimize an instance-discrimination loss between two augmented views of the same image [ 31 , 16 ] , rewarding invariance to augmentations and suppressing augmentation-induced pixel variance by construction. We use MoCo-v3 [ 17 ] as the canonical modern image–image contrastive recipe. Sequence-aware TR variants such as SeqCLR [ 4 ] , PerSec [ 40 ] , ChaCo [ 65 ] , CMT-Co [ 64 ] , and RCLSTR [ 63 ] reorganize the contrastive unit (frame, character, subword) but inherit the underlying MoCo-style image–image objective; testing MoCo-v3 directly characterizes that shared foundation.
blocks.zh: 图像 - 图像对比方法优化了同一图像的两种增益视图[31,16]之间的实例区分损失,奖励了对增益的偏差,并通过构建抑制增益引发的像素差异. 我们使用MoCo-v3[17]作为犬科现代形象-形象对比配方. 序列-意识TR变体,如SeqCLR [4],PerSec [40],ChaCo [65],CMT-Co [64],以及RCLSTR [63] 重组对比单位(框架,字符,子词),但继承了基本的MoCo风格图像-图像目标;测试MoCo-v3直接定性了共享的基础.

blocks.en: Image–text contrastive methods pull line images with the same transcription toward the same representation, regardless of writer or style [ 52 , 62 ] . We use SigLIP [ 62 ] , the only method in our comparison with access to transcription-level supervision during pretraining.
blocks.zh: 图片 - 文本对比法将同样抄写过的图像拉向相同的代表,无论写作或风格[52,62]. 我们使用SigLIP[62],这是我们与在预训期间获得抄录级监督相比的唯一方法.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation protocols
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价协议

blocks.en: We evaluate each pretrained encoder under three protocols, reporting Character Error Rate (CER) on the test split of each benchmark, using the best validation checkpoint. The visual-only protocols (Linear–CTC, BiLSTM–CTC) freeze the encoder and read out from its features without a language prior, isolating what the encoder itself exposes. Each probe is trained on the real training split of each benchmark and evaluated on its test split. The LLM-based protocol (LLaVA-style familiy [ 41 , 39 , 42 ] ) connects the encoder to a pretrained causal language model; we report it under both encoder-frozen training (Stage 1) and full fine-tuning (Stage 2).
blocks.zh: 我们利用最佳验证检查点,根据三个协议对每个预装编码器进行评估,在每个基准的测试分数上报告字符错误率。 仅可视化的协议(Linear-CTC, BiLSTM-CTC)冻结编码器, 并从它的特性中读出, 而不事先使用语言, 每个探测器都接受关于每个基准的实际训练分数的培训,并按试验分数进行评估。 基于LLM的协议(LLAVA-style familiy [41, 39, 42])将编码器与预先训练的因果语言模型连接起来;我们在编码器-冻结训练(Stage 1)和完全微调(Stage 2)下报告.

blocks.en: A single linear projection from frozen encoder features to character logits, trained with a CTC objective [ 28 ] . This is the strictest probe: with no temporal smoothing or language prior, its CER reflects what the encoder exposes at each spatial position.
blocks.zh: 从冷冻编码器特性到字符日志的单一线性投影,训练有CTC目标[28]. 这是最严格的探测器:在没有时间平滑或语言之前,其CER反映了编码器在每个空间位置暴露的内容.

blocks.en: A bidirectional LSTM head over frozen features, followed by a linear projection and CTC objective [ 28 ] . The BiLSTM provides sequence-level integration that the linear probe lacks; comparing the two probes (see Sec. 5.2 ) tells us how much character information is exposed per-position versus reconstructed by the readout.
blocks.zh: 双向LSTM头顶于冷冻特征,然后是线性投影和CTC目标[28]. BiLSTM提供了线性探测器缺乏的序列级集成;比较了两个探测器(见Sec 5.2),告诉我们每个位置有多少字符信息被曝光,相对于读出器重建.

blocks.en: Pretrained LLM (multi-stage fine-tuning). A linear projector connects the encoder to a pretrained causal language model. We pretrain the LM from scratch on a multilingual subset of CC100 [ 18 ] covering English, French, Italian, Spanish, and German, sized to match the decoder of TrOCR-B [ 38 ] . Following the standard LP-then-FT recipe of modern decoder-only vision–language models [ 41 , 39 , 42 ] , we train the readout in three stages. In Stage 1 (alignment) , the encoder and the LM are frozen, and only the projector is trained on synthetic image–label pairs to align the visual feature space with the LM’s embedding space. In Stage 2 (encoder-frozen fine-tuning) , the projector and the LM are jointly fine-tuned on each real dataset’s training split, with the encoder still frozen. In Stage 3 (full fine-tuning) , the encoder is unfrozen and trained jointly with the projector and the LM at a lower learning rate. We report this protocol under two configurations: an encoder-frozen configuration (Stages 1+2) and a full fine-tuning configuration (Stages 1+2+3).
blocks.zh: 预训LLM(多级微调). 线性投影仪将编码器连接到预先训练的因果语言模型. 我们从零开始将LM从一个包含英语,法语,意大利语,西班牙语和德语的CC100[18]的多语种子集上预演,大小与TrOCR-B[38]的解码器相匹配. 遵循现代解码器唯一的视觉-语言模型[41,39,42]的标准LP-when-FT配方,我们分三个阶段训练读取. 在阶段1(对齐)中,编码器和LM被冷冻,只有投影仪接受过合成图像的训练–标签配对,使视觉特征空间与LM的嵌入空间一致. 在第二阶段(编码-冻结微调),投影仪和LM在每一个真正的数据集的训练分拆上共同微调,编码器仍然被冻结. 在第3阶段(完全微调)中,编码器解冻,与投影仪和LM联合训练,学习率较低. 我们在两个配置下报告这个协议:一个编码器-冻结配置(1+2)和一个完整的微调配置(1+2+3).

blocks.en: 4.3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.3 实验装置

blocks.en: We use a single ViT-B-scale backbone ( 113.55 113.55 M parameters) across all six SSL methods. ViT-B is the standard architectural scale in modern SSL benchmarks [ 30 , 59 , 7 , 62 ] and matches the encoder used by TrOCR-B [ 38 ] , making our results directly comparable to supervised baselines. Following Lyu et al. [44] , we use vertical strip patch embedding to match line geometry; this is the only architectural concession to the HTR domain. Implementation details are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们对所有六种SSL方法使用单一的ViT-B级主干(113.55 113.55 M参数). ViT-B是现代SSL基准中的标准建筑尺度[30,59,7,62],与TrOCR-B[38]使用的编码器相匹配,使我们的结果直接可与受监督的基线相比. 继Lyu等人[44]之后,我们使用垂直的条状补丁嵌入来匹配线状几何;这是HTR域唯一的建筑特许. 执行情况详情见附录B。

blocks.en: For the LLM-based protocol (Sec. 4.2 ), we use a single decoder shared across all SSL methods. The decoder is a 200 200 M-parameter causal LM, sized to match TrOCR-B’s, pretrained from scratch on a multilingual subset of CC100 [ 18 ] covering the five languages of our benchmarks. Per-stage hyperparameters and training schedules are in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 对于基于LLM的协议(Sec.4.2),我们使用所有SSL方法共享的单一解码器. 解码器是一个200M参数的因果LM, 尺寸与TrOCR-B的尺寸相符, 每个阶段的超参数和培训时间表载于附录F。

blocks.en: Real handwriting comes from six benchmarks covering five languages and historical periods from medieval to modern: IAM [ 45 ] (English), RIMES [ 34 ] (French), Bentham [ 15 ] (19th-century English), LAM [ 14 ] (Italian), Rodrigo [ 55 ] (16th-century Spanish), and Parzival [ 23 ] (medieval German). We use the canonical line-level train/val/test splits for each benchmark (totals and details in Appendix C ). Synthetic line images are rendered from approximately 3,000 3{,}000 handwritten fonts paired with multilingual text from Project Gutenberg [ 27 ] , yielding 2.5 2.5 M lines per language balanced across English, French, Italian, Spanish, and German ( 12.5 12.5 M lines total). Rendering details (font sampling, line-length distribution, augmentation) are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 真实的笔迹来自涵盖5种语言的6个基准以及从中世纪到现代的历史时期:IAM [45] (英语),RIMES [34] (法语),Bentham [15] (19世纪英语),LAM [14] (意大利语),Rodrigo [55] (16世纪西班牙语),以及Parzival [23] (medeval German). 我们使用每个基准(附录C中的总数和详细情况)的舟线级列车/值/测试分数。 合成线图象由约3000 3{,}000个手写字体与来自Gutenberg项目[27]的多语种文本对齐而成,在英语,法语,意大利语,西班牙语和德语之间均衡的每种语言产生2.5 M线(共12.5 m线). 渲染细节(丰度取样、线长分布、增强)载于附录C。

blocks.en: We pretrain each SSL method under two regimes. In the synthetic regime, the encoder is pretrained on the 12.5 12.5 M-line synthetic corpus. In the real regime, the encoder is pretrained on the union of the six benchmarks’ training splits. Comparing the two regimes tests whether the relative behavior of SSL families is intrinsic to the family or specific to the pretraining distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们在两种制度下对每种SSL方法进行预先训练. 在合成制中,编码器在12.5 12.5 M线合成体上预先训练. 在真正的政权中,编码器在六个基准的训练分开后预先接受训练。 比较两种制度,可以检验SSL家庭的相对行为是家庭所固有的,还是培训前的分布所特有的.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:

We document this through five complementary experiments: a frozen-encoder probe

features to CER (Sec. 5.3 ), a comparison against fully
supervised state-of-the-art HTR baselines (Sec. 5.4 ), and an
evaluation of label efficiency under limited supervision
(Sec. 5.5 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Pixel-grounded SSL produces the most readable encoder
blocks.zh: 5.1 以像素为基础的SSL生产最可读编码器

blocks.en: Pixel-grounded SSL produces the lowest probe CER under both pretraining regimes. We freeze each pretrained encoder and train a one-layer BiLSTM–CTC probe per benchmark; the probe is the most direct measurement of encoder quality available, since it removes language priors and decoder capacity from the picture. Fig. 3 reports the mean test CER across the six real HTR datasets for every method, in both synthetic and real pretraining regimes. Under real pretraining, pixel-grounded SSL is on top: MAE reaches 5.5 % 5.5\% mean CER and SimMIM 8.7 % 8.7\% , followed by V-JEPA-2 ( 10.6 % 10.6\% ), then SigLIP ( 14.5 % 14.5\% ) and I-JEPA ( 14.7 % 14.7\% ), with MoCo-v3 last ( 19.2 % 19.2\% ).
blocks.zh: 以像素为基础 SSL在两种预训制度下产生最低的探测器CER. 我们冻结了每个预先训练的编码器,并每个基准训练一个单层的BILSTM-CTC探测器;该探测器是对编码器质量最直接的测量,因为它从图片中删除了语言前身和解码能力. 图3报告在合成和真实的预训练制度中,对每一种方法的六个真正的HTR数据集进行平均测试CER。 在真正的预训下,以像素为基础的SSL处于顶端:MAE达到5.5% 5.5 = 平均CER和SimMIM 8.7% = 8.7 = ,其次是V-JEPA-2(10.6% 10.6 = ),然后是SigLIP(14.5% 14.5 = )和I-JEPA(10.7% 14.7 = ),最后是MoCo-v3(19.2% 19.2 = )。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Frozen-encoder BiLSTM–CTC probe CER, mean across six benchmarks. Solid bars: synthetic pretraining; hatched bars: real pretraining. Δ \Delta values report the synth-to-real shift in mean CER. Only pixel-grounded methods improve with real-data SSL; JEPA and contrastive methods degrade. Error bars span the per-benchmark range.
blocks.zh: 图3:冻结编码器BILSTM – CTC探测CER,指跨越6个基准. 固体条:合成预训;孵化条:真预训. \\Delta值报告平均CER的合成到实际的转变。 只有以像素为基础的方法才能随着真实数据SSL而改进;JEPA和对比方法可以降解. 横跨每个基准范围的错误栏。

blocks.en: Only pixel-grounded SSL benefits from real-data pretraining; every other family degrades. The Δ \Delta values in Fig. 3 report each method’s synth-to-real shift in mean CER. MAE and SimMIM improve substantially when SSL is run on real handwriting (MAE: − 2.9 -2.9 pp; SimMIM: − 3.8 -3.8 pp). The other four methods worsen instead: V-JEPA-2 ( + 1.9 +1.9 pp), SigLIP ( + 1.7 +1.7 pp), I-JEPA ( + 4.6 +4.6 pp), and MoCo-v3 ( + 5.2 +5.2 pp). The structural account explains the asymmetry: pixel-grounded objectives are aligned with the variance directions that carry the HTR signal, so more real handwriting helps the encoder. The other families’ objectives either ignore (JEPA) or actively suppress (contrastive) the high-variance pixel content, and exposing them to more real handwriting at SSL time amplifies the misalignment.
blocks.zh: 只有以像素为基础的SSL受益于真实数据预训;其他每个家族都会退化. 图3中的 & Delta 值报告每种方法在平均CER中的合成变化。 当SSL用真实的笔迹运行时,MAE和SimMIM大为改善(MAE:− 2.9-2.9页;SimMIM:− 3.8-3.8页)。 其他四种方法反而恶化:V-JEPA-2(+1.9+1.9页)、SigLIP(+1.7+1.7页)、I-JEPA(+4.6+4.6页)和MoCo-v3(+5.2+5.2页)。 结构账户解释不对称:像素基底目标与带HTR信号的变异方向一致,所以更多的真实的笔迹帮助编码器. 其他家庭的目标要么忽略(JEPA),要么积极压制(反复)高变异像素内容,让他们在SSL时间接触到更真实的笔迹会放大错位.

blocks.en: 5.2 Pixel-grounded encoders preserve sequential structure
blocks.zh: 5.2 像素定位编码器保持顺序结构

blocks.en: Pixel-grounded encoders expose per-position character information; everything else needs the readout to recover it. A BiLSTM in the readout can recover per-position character information that the encoder did not encode itself, by integrating over the sequence. To separate what the encoder exposes from what the readout reconstructs, we replace the BiLSTM with a single linear layer trained per spatial position (Linear–CTC protocol) and report the gap Δ = Linear CER − BiLSTM CER \Delta=\text{Linear CER}-\text{BiLSTM CER} . A small Δ \Delta means the encoder already exposes character information at each position. A large Δ \Delta means the encoder’s per-position output is uninformative and the readout must do the work.
blocks.zh: 以像素定位的编码器会曝光每个位置的字符信息;其他一切需要读出才能恢复. 读取中的一种BiLSTM可以通过集成到序列上来恢复编码器本身没有编码的每个位置的字符信息. 为了区分编码器暴露在读出重建中的内容,我们用每个空间位置训练的单线性层(Linear-CTC协议)取代BiLSTM,并报告空隙QQ = Linear CER − BiLSTM CER\Delta=\Text{Linear CER}-\text{BiLSTM [CER]. 一个小的QQ\Delta表示编码器已经在每个位置暴露人物信息. 大型 \\ Delta 表示编码器的每个位置输出不具有信息化性,读出必须完成工作.

blocks.en: Table 1: Frozen-encoder BiLSTM–CTC test CER ( % \% , ↓ \downarrow ), with Linear–CTC rescue gap Δ \Delta (in pp, in red ). Real-pretrained encoders. Bold = = best per column, underline = = 2nd best.
blocks.zh: 表1:冰冻编码器 BILSTM – CTC测试 CER (% \%, ↓ \ down down down),与 Linear – CTC 救援缺口 → Delta (在pp中,用红色表示). 真正的预选编码器。 粗体==每列最好,下划线==第2名.

blocks.en: The rescue gap separates the families as cleanly as the BiLSTM CER itself. Pixel-grounded encoders need almost no rescue: MAE has a 5.7 5.7 pp average gap, SimMIM 10.3 10.3 pp. JEPA encoders need substantially more (V-JEPA-2: 26.6 26.6 pp; I-JEPA: 39.0 39.0 pp), and contrastive encoders the most (SigLIP: 29.5 29.5 pp; MoCo-v3: 59.1 59.1 pp). MAE’s per-position output is the most informative on every benchmark, both in raw CER and in the size of the rescue gap. MoCo-v3’s per-position output is the least informative: a linear probe on its frozen features reaches CERs far from the BiLSTM ceiling, and most of the transcription quality on the BiLSTM line is reconstructed by the readout itself. The structural account predicts this directly: an encoder that preserves the high-variance pixel subspace, which carries the stroke content, exposes character information at every spatial position the readout can read.
blocks.zh: 救援缺口像BiLSTM CER本身一样干净地将家庭分开. 像素定位编码器几乎不需要救援: MAE的平均值差距为5.7页,SimMIM 10.3 10.3页。 JEPA编码器需要的要多得多(V-JEPA-2:26.626.6页;I-JEPA:39.0 39.0页),对比编码器最多(SigLIP:29.5 29.5页;MoCo-v3:59.159.1页)。 MAE的每个位置输出,无论是在原始CER还是救援缺口的大小上,在每个基准上信息最丰富. MoCo-v3的每个位置输出信息最少:对其冷冻特征的线性探测器到达了远离BiLSTM天花板的CER,BiLSTM线上大部分的抄录质量由读取器自己重建. 结构账户直接预测了这一点:一个能保存带有中风内容的高变位像素子空间的编码器,在读取器可以读取的每一个空间位置都暴露人物信息.

blocks.en: 5.3 Encoder–subspace alignment explains CER
blocks.zh: 5.3 编码器 - 子空间对齐解释 CER

blocks.en: We now ask whether the same property explains the encoder-level results: do encoders whose features carry more of the high-variance pixel content achieve lower CER? We extend the linear-probing methodology of Balestriero and Lecun [10] from natural-image classification to HTR encoders. Their analysis projected images onto top- K K or bot- K K pixel-PCA subspaces and showed that classifiers trained on the bottom subspace outperform those trained on the top. We apply the same projection-then-probe construction at the encoder level: instead of asking how well a classifier reads characters from each subspace, we ask how well the encoder’s features themselves can be linearly recovered from each subspace.
blocks.zh: 我们现在问同一属性是否解释了编码器级别的结果:其特性包含更多高变异像素内容的编码器是否实现了较低的CER? 我们把Balestriero和Lecun的线性测试方法[10]从自然成像分类扩展到HTR编码器. 他们的分析将图像投射到顶端的K K 或 bot- K K 像素- PCA 子空间,并显示在底端子空间上训练的分类器比在顶端训练的分类器要好。 我们在编码器层面应用相同的投影-当时的探测构造:我们不问一个分类器从每个子空间读取字符有多好,而是问编码器的特性本身可从每个子空间线性恢复到什么程度。

Fig. 4 plots the per-dataset R 2 R^{2} -gap against the encoder’s frozen BiLSTM–CTC probe CER on that dataset, one panel per SSL method. blocks.en: 5.4 SSL encoders compete with supervised SOTA HTR
blocks.zh: 5.4 SSL编码器与受监管的SOTA HTR竞争

blocks.en: The probes of Sec. 5.1 – 5.3 measure properties of the encoder in isolation. They show that pixel-grounded encoders preserve what HTR readouts need, but leave open whether this advantage translates to a complete HTR system competitive with the supervised state of the art. We test this with the LLaVA-style three-stage pipeline of Sec. 4.2 under two configurations: an encoder-frozen configuration (Stage 1 alignment on synthetic data, then Stage 2 fine-tuning of the projector and LM on each real dataset), which isolates the contribution of the SSL representation; and a full fine-tuning configuration that adds Stage 3, unfreezing the encoder and training the entire system. To ensure equal training conditions, all supervised baselines (CRNN, DTrOCR B , TrOCR B ) follow the same data schedule: full supervised training on our 12.5 12.5 M-line synthetic corpus, followed by full fine-tuning on each real dataset’s training split. Both configurations are reported in Table 2 .

blocks.en: A frozen pixel-grounded encoder is already competitive with supervised SOTA, and full fine-tuning beats it. Under the encoder-frozen configuration, MAE achieves 5.1 % 5.1\% mean CER, lower than CRNN ( 5.5 % 5.5\% ), DTrOCR B ( 5.6 % 5.6\% ), and the no-SSL control ( 5.7 % 5.7\% ), and within 0.4 0.4 pp of TrOCR B ( 4.7 % 4.7\% ), the strongest supervised baseline. The encoder receives no gradient updates at any point in this configuration. Under full fine-tuning, MAE reaches 4.5 % 4.5\% mean CER, the lowest result in the table and below TrOCR B ’s 4.7 % 4.7\% , and ranks first or second in every column. The gain from the encoder-frozen to the full fine-tuning configuration is small for MAE ( − 0.6 -0.6 pp on the mean), confirming that its frozen representation was already close to ceiling; SimMIM, JEPA, and contrastive encoders gain more from full fine-tuning ( 1.0 1.0 to 1.1 1.1 pp on the mean), consistent with the rescue-gap finding of Sec. 5.2 that their representations require more downstream work to be useful.

blocks.en: The family ordering is preserved across both configurations. MAE is first under both encoder-frozen and full fine-tuning; SimMIM and V-JEPA-2 sit in the middle; SigLIP is last among SSL methods. The LLM decoder lowers absolute CER uniformly across encoders but does not reorder them, indicating that the language prior cannot recover information the encoder did not expose. The advantage of pixel-grounded SSL is therefore intrinsic to the representation, not an artifact of decoder capacity or training protocol.

blocks.en: 5.5 Pixel-grounded SSL needs fewer labels
blocks.zh: 5.5 以像素为基础的SSL需要较少的标签

blocks.en: We test whether pixel-grounded SSL retains its advantage when transcription labels are scarce. For each encoder pretrained on real handwriting, we freeze its weights and train the same BiLSTM readout with CTC loss on nested subsets containing 1%, 10%, 25%, 50%, or 100% of the labeled training data. Figure 5 reports mean test CER across the real HTR benchmarks; per benchmark results appear in Appendix E .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Pixel-grounded SSL wins on every measure we test for HTR, and the structural account of Sec. 3 explains why: HTR’s discriminative signal lives in the high-variance pixel subspace, the inverse of natural-image classification. The pattern is sharpened by an asymmetry in the synth-to-real shift: pixel-grounded methods are the only family that benefits from real-data SSL, while JEPA-style and contrastive methods degrade when given the same real handwriting. The same encoder-level alignment property explains why: the encoder’s geometric preference for the high-variance pixel subspace is what makes more real handwriting useful, and it predicts CER within every encoder we test, regardless of family. These results challenge a dominant assumption in self-supervised vision: that pixel reconstruction wastes capacity on detail irrelevant to perception. The assumption holds for tasks whose signal lives in low-variance pixel directions, but not for transcription, where the high-variance stroke detail JEPA-style methods discard is the signal itself. The same argument should apply to other tasks whose discriminative content lives in high-variance pixel directions, such as scene text recognition and music notation recognition; we leave systematic verification to future work. Beyond the structural account, our pipeline produces a state-of-the-art HTR system: under matched training conditions, our MAE-pretrained encoder paired with a pretrained LLM decoder achieves 4.5 % 4.5\% mean CER across six benchmarks (vs. TrOCR-B’s 4.7 % 4.7\% ) and ranks first or second on every benchmark.
blocks.zh: 以像素为基础 SSL在我们测试HTR的每一个度量上都胜出,Sec. 3的结构账户解释了为什么:HTR的歧义信号生活在高变异像素亚空间,即自然图像分类的反向. 该图案在合成到现实的变迁中被不对称化而磨损:像素基底方法是唯一从真实数据SSL中受益的家族,而JEPA的风格和对比法则在得到同样真实的笔迹后退化. 同样的编码器级对齐属性解释了原因:编码器对高变异像素子空间的几何偏好使得笔迹更加真实有用,它预言我们测试的每一个编码器内部的CER,无论家族如何. 这些结果对自我监督的愿景中的主要假设提出了挑战:在细节上像素重建废物的能力与感知无关。 假设是用于其信号生活在低变异像素方向上的任务,但不用于转录,其中高变异的中风细节JEPA式的方法抛弃是信号本身. 同样的论据也应适用于其歧视性内容以高度变异像素方向存在的其他任务,例如场景文本识别和音乐标记识别;我们将系统核查留待今后的工作. 除了结构账户之外,我们的管道还生产出最先进的HTR系统:在匹配的训练条件下,我们的MAE预装编码器与经过预装的LLM解码器配对,在六个基准(vs.TrOCR-B的4.7 % 4.7)中实现4.5 % 的 CER,并在每一个基准中排名第一或第二。

blocks.en: We test a single encoder scale (ViT-B) and a single seed per experiment. Our benchmarks are Latin-script only; whether the structural account holds for non-Latin scripts (Arabic, Chinese, Devanagari) is untested. The account also predicts the same logic for other high-variance-signal transcription tasks (scene text, optical music recognition, mathematical expression recognition), which we do not test directly.
blocks.zh: 我们每个实验测试一个单一编码器尺度(ViT-B)和一个单一种子. 我们的基准只有拉丁字母;结构账户是否为非拉丁文(阿拉伯语、中文、德瓦纳加里语)所持有。 该账号还预测了其他高变异信号的转录任务(场景文本,光学音乐识别,数学表达识别)的相同逻辑,我们不直接测试.

We pretrain six self-supervised encoder methods representing three different families with the same backbone, the
same input pipeline, and the same optimizer recipe, varying only the
family-specific loss and prediction head. We first describe the shared setup

On real handwriting pretraining and on supervised stages we apply a fixed
augmentation pipeline at training time only. The pipeline mixes geometric

additive Gaussian noise), random ink dilation or erosion with small kernels
applied at low probability, and a low-probability cutout that erases small
rectangular regions and fills them with the page background. Validation and
test sets receive no augmentation, and synthetic images are not augmented
because their generator already exposes substantial font, ink, and background
variation.

blocks.en: B.1 MAE.

blocks.en:
MAE is the canonical pixel-grounded masked image modeling family [ 30 ] : predict the missing patches of an image in pixel space.
The encoder is the shared vertical-patch ViT described above.
The decoder is a small four-block transformer with hidden dimension 256 and
eight attention heads (4.5M parameters at base), and it predicts the pixel
intensities of the masked patches. We use random patch masking at a 75% rate, so the encoder processes
only the visible 25% of patches while the decoder receives the encoder
outputs together with learned mask tokens at the masked positions. The
training objective is mean squared error on the pixel block of each masked
patch only; we do not normalise target pixels, predicting raw intensities
directly.

blocks.en:
SimMIM is also a pixel-grounded masked image modeling family [ 59 ] , but with a lightweight single-layer linear projection
in place of MAE’s transformer decoder. The encoder is the same vertical-patch
ViT, and in contrast to MAE the masked patches are kept at the encoder input
as learnable mask tokens. The mask predictor is a single linear projection
from encoder hidden states to pixel intensities of each masked patch. We use
random patch masking at a 60% rate and an L1 reconstruction loss on masked
patches only.

blocks.en: B.3 I-JEPA (and JEPA adaptation to HTR).

blocks.en:
I-JEPA is a joint-embedding predictive architecture [ 7 ] :
it predicts feature-space representations of masked target patches from
feature-space representations of an unmasked context. The original
formulation targets square natural images with a 2D patch grid, samples
target blocks as random rectangles in 2D, and samples a single context
block per image. None of these choices transfers cleanly to long, single-row
line images, where the only meaningful axis is left-to-right and where
2D rectangular masks would span multiple words horizontally while leaving
full character height visible at the top and bottom of the image. We adapt
I-JEPA to HTR along three axes: input geometry, masking strategy, and
loss aggregation.

它预示着蒙面目标补丁的特征-空间表示

blocks.en:
Input geometry. We treat each line image as a 1D sequence of T = 256 T=256 full-height vertical patches (Sec. B ),
not as a 2D grid; the encoder, the target encoder, and the predictor all
operate on a single time axis with 1D rotary positional encodings. There
is no 2D positional grid, no class token, and no separate spatial pooling.
Compared to the original 2D I-JEPA, we drop both the global-context
prefix (the original samples a large context block then crops, which is
ill-defined on long aspect ratios) and the 2D block sampler.

blocks.en:
Masking strategy. For each line we sample
( M = 4 M=4 ) independent target masks; this matches the multi-block
recipe later popularised by V-JEPA. Each target mask is a single contiguous
1D span whose width, expressed as a fraction of T T , is drawn uniformly from [ 0.15 , 0.25 ] [0.15,0.25] , and whose left edge is drawn uniformly over the valid
positions. We then form a single context mask by taking the
complement of the union of the four target masks. Because target spans
overlap freely, the context can be small (we observed roughly 30 30 – 50 % 50\% of the line in expectation); we do not enforce a minimum context size.
This differs from canonical I-JEPA in three ways: (i) we sample multiple
disjoint targets per image rather than one, (ii) we do not crop a separate
context block, and (iii) all spans are 1D rather than 2D rectangles.
Bidirectional self-attention is used inside both the encoder and the
predictor; we did not find a benefit from causal masking on the context
side, consistent with the original I-JEPA results.

Targets. Target representations come from an exponential moving average copy of the

Instance normalisation matters. Per-patch instance
normalisation of the EMA targets is essential: without it, both I-JEPA and

zero within a few thousand steps, the predictor learns the trivial

constant across patches. We observed this collapse consistently on both
synthetic and real handwriting; instance-normalising targets along the
embedding dimension before computing the loss eliminates the collapse and
recovers stable training. We report all I-JEPA and V-JEPA-2 numbers with
instance normalisation enabled.

blocks.en:
SigLIP is a sigmoid contrastive image and text pretraining family [ 62 ] . The image encoder is the same vertical-patch ViT as
the MIM and JEPA families, with patch features mean-pooled across the 256
patches into a single image embedding. The text encoder is a six-layer causal
transformer of the same width as the image encoder, operating on BPE-8192
tokenised text; the final token’s hidden state is the text embedding. Both
modalities are linearly projected to a shared 256-dimensional space and
L2-normalised, and similarity is the dot product scaled by a learned
temperature. At base, the image encoder, text encoder, and projection heads
together total about 228 228 M parameters.

blocks.en:
MoCo-v3 is a momentum contrastive image-only pretraining family [ 17 ] . We adapt it to sequential line images via a
window-level positive pairing. Each image yields two augmented views (the
same augmentation pipeline applied twice independently), and each view is
divided into four contiguous windows along the time axis. The positive for a
given window in one view is the window at the same horizontal position in
the other view, while all other windows in the batch serve as negatives.
This is the digital-image-grounded variant of MoCo-v3 with a sequential
prior, and it allows contrastive learning on long line images without
collapsing to image-level matching.

LLaVA-style decoder-only vision and language model. The frozen pretrained
SSL encoder (114M parameters at base, 403M at large) produces a sequence of
256 image patch features. A two-layer MLP modality projector (about 7.3M
parameters at base) maps encoder features to the decoder’s hidden
dimension. The decoder is a pretrained causal language model with twelve
transformer layers, hidden dimension 1024 1024 , sixteen heads, rotary
positions, and weight-tied token embedding (about 218M parameters at base);
it is pretrained on multilingual CC-100 text [ 18 ] (English, Spanish, French,
German, Italian) under a standard next-token cross-entropy objective with
the same Byte-Pair Encoding with a vocab of 8192 used everywhere else. The BPE-8192 tokenizer is
built on the same multilingual CC-100 [ 18 ] corpus before LM pretraining.

blocks.en: Appendix G Evaluation protocol and baselines
blocks.zh: 附录G 评价协议和基线

blocks.en:
We evaluate using Character Error Rate (CER), defined as the Levenshtein
distance between prediction and reference divided by the reference length and
averaged uniformly across the test set; lower is better. For both probes and
the VLM pipeline we pick the checkpoint that minimises validation CER and
report that checkpoint’s test CER. Decoding is greedy CTC for the probes and
greedy autoregressive decoding (no beam search) for the VLM, and we did not
tune decoding hyperparameters. Probe and VLM evaluation are reported on the raw transcript with no case
folding and no punctuation stripping.

blocks.en: The supervised baselines in Table 2 differ in their pretraining starting points, which we disclose here for transparency. TrOCR-B [ 38 ] is initialised from the publicly released TrOCR-B checkpoint, which was pretrained on roughly 684M synthetic printed-text line images derived from PDF documents and Wikipedia text, and is then fine-tuned on our synthetic corpus and on each real dataset under our matched protocol. Our synthetic corpus contains 12.5 12.5 M handwriting line images, so TrOCR-B begins our pipeline with substantially more pretraining exposure than the SSL methods, which see only the unlabeled real handwriting at SSL time and our 12.5 12.5 M synthetic lines at the supervised stage. DTrOCR [ 24 ] does not have a publicly released checkpoint, so we initialise it from scratch and train it under the same matched protocol (full SFT on our synthetic corpus, then per-dataset full fine-tuning on real data). CRNN [ 50 ] is also trained from scratch under the matched protocol. The SSL methods and the no-SSL Random init. row are likewise trained from scratch using the commong backbone except for the SSL pretraining stage, which uses only the unlabeled real handwriting.
